title: Museum QR Suite
spec: Museum toolkit: exhibit QR, audio-guide QR, ticket QR, donation QR presets — each generating a working QR code.

title: Library QR Suite
spec: Library toolkit: catalogue QR, event QR, membership QR, book-label QR presets — each generating a working QR code.

title: Warehouse QR Suite
spec: Warehouse toolkit: bin-location QR, stock-check QR, pick-list QR, asset QR presets — each generating a working QR code.

title: Farm QR Suite
spec: Farm toolkit: produce-traceability QR, farm-shop QR, market-stall QR, CSA-signup QR presets — each generating a working QR code.

title: Taxi QR Suite
spec: Taxi toolkit: booking QR, driver-profile QR, fare-estimate QR, receipt QR presets — each generating a working QR code.

title: QR Redirect Chain Viewer
spec: Paste a QR destination URL; parses redirects in the chain client-side (host/path/params per hop) and flags risky hops.

title: QR Payload Inspector
spec: Upload a QR image; decodes it in-browser (jsQR), then classifies the payload type and lists every field it contains.

title: QR Allowlist Builder
spec: Build a domain allowlist for your QR codes: add/remove domains, import/export JSON, and test URLs against it.

title: QR Metadata Stripper
spec: Strip EXIF/metadata from a QR image in-browser (canvas re-encode) before you share it; shows what was removed.

title: QR Offline Verifier
spec: Verify a QR payload without network: format checks, length, encoding, and a scannability self-test checklist.

title: QR Tamper Evidence Planner
spec: Answer placement/material questions; generates a tamper-evidence spec (seal type, inspection cadence, escalation).

title: QR Expiry Checker
spec: Check whether a QR destination is expired, redirected, or dead via a client-side fetch attempt with clear verdicts and caveats.

title: QR Checksum Generator
spec: Generate SHA-256 checksums for QR payloads so recipients can verify a printed code has not been altered.

title: QR Scan Log
spec: Log your own QR scans locally (browser storage): date, location note, verdict; filter and export the log as CSV.

title: QR Consent Note Builder
spec: Build a short consent/privacy note to place next to a data-collecting QR code, from purpose + retention answers.

title: QR Print Proof Checklist
spec: Interactive pre-press checklist (size, contrast, quiet zone, test scans); produces a printable sign-off sheet.

title: QR Signature Note Builder
spec: Build a signed-URL note template: payload + checksum + verification steps a recipient can follow.

title: QR Batch Validator
spec: Validate many QR destination URLs at once (format, scheme, length, duplicate detection) with a pass/fail table.

title: QR Typosquat Checker
spec: Compare a domain against common typo variants (omission, swap, homoglyph lookalikes) and flag risky lookalikes.

title: QR Phishing Pattern Trainer
spec: Interactive trainer: 10 realistic QR scenarios; you judge safe/unsafe and get an explanation for each.
